typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Location as string,
		Primary as string,
		Failover as string,
		{Location Alias} as string,
		Voltage as string,
		Rating as decimal(18,0),
		{Primary Current} as double,
		{Failover Current} as double,
		{Power (kW)} as double,
		{Peak (kW)} as double,
		{Average (kW)} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		FailoverCurrent as double,
		LocationAlias as string,
		AveragekW as double,
		Rating as integer,
		PowerkW as double,
		PeakkW as double,
		FName as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		Failover as string,
		PrimaryCurrent as double,
		Primary as string,
		Voltage as string,
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		FailoverCurrent = {Failover Current},
		LocationAlias = {Location Alias},
		AveragekW = {Average (kW)},
		Rating,
		PowerkW = {Power (kW)},
		PeakkW = {Peak (kW)},
		FName,
		EtlUser,
		Failover,
		PrimaryCurrent = {Primary Current},
		Primary,
		Voltage,
		Location),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
